mapper.select: SELECT id, name, email, phone, DATE_FORMAT(birth_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS birthDate, address, status, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt FROM member ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member
name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT id, name, email, phone, DATE_FORMAT(birth_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS birthDate, address, status, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt FROM member WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (name, email, phone, birth_date, address, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{birthDate}, #{address}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'))
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET name = #{name}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, address = #{address}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
